# c2-chat-power-user: heavy chat use

Target: long and messy chat sessions: threads, chat management, search, quoting, attachments and model errors.
Risks: messages lost, reordered or rendered wrong, chat changes that do not stick, attachments that are not sent or
cannot be opened, an app that does not recover from a model error.
Start state: fresh user, desktop viewport, fake AI (select "Opus 5").
Out of bounds: settings, skills, projects, account deletion.
